text.zh: 1. 一级是年/月，二级在当前月内按日期分组。
text.en: 1. Level one is year/month; level two groups by date within the current month.

text.zh: 2. 点标题就地展开，不跳页。
text.en: 2. Tapping a header expands in place; no page jump.

text.zh: 3. 分组计数取同一份列表，避免两处数字不一样。
text.en: 3. Group counts come from the same list, so numbers can't disagree.

note.zh: 纯文本编辑器不做富文本；换行原样保留
note.en: Plain text only; line breaks are preserved
